interpretation: Schema-owned byte counts are not a license to strip fields: they include simulation, pathfinding, cluster/PVS, sound, and presentation data. The compressed-vertex projection is arithmetic only; the data supports CE visual surface/material/light queries and has no proven equivalent in the PS2 BSPS pack. CBSP v1 round trips are checked per block, but no block is stripped or declared PS2-capacity-safe. It does not charge storage for an external copy. Each omission still requires CE consumer and parity evidence.
